allow: PowerShell(foreach \($n in @\('DEEPGRAM_API_KEY','ANTHROPIC_API_KEY','CARTESIA_API_KEY','OPENAI_API_KEY'\)\) { $v = [Environment]::GetEnvironmentVariable\($n\); if \([string]::IsNullOrEmpty\($v\)\) { "$n = \(not set\)" } else { "$n = SET \(length $\($v.Length\)\)" } })

PowerShell($ok=$false; for\($i=0;$i -lt 20;$i++\){ try{ $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri "http://localhost:7860/client" -UseBasicParsing -TimeoutSec 3; "HTTP $\($r.StatusCode\) - content-length $\($r.Content.Length\)"; $ok=$true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 700 } }; if\(-not $ok\){ "did not respond after ~14s" })
